scope: Ordered authored polygons and palette compared to native SVG paths; current artifact hashes recorded

tolerances.colorReason: Blender 5.2 native SVG export converts linear RGB to sRGB and truncates uint8 channels; allow at most one level of drift

limits: This script does not open Blender; saved-master readback and reload provenance come from the supplied evidence files
PNG hashes and 64x64 headers are checked here; rasterization and review crop parity are recorded separately in review/qa.json
Mechanical parity does not establish aesthetic approval, animation quality, or game acceptance

blenderReadbackParity.scope: Compare the supplied readback from the reopened master; this verifier does not call Blender

savedFileReloadEvidence.scope: Validate supplied before/after hashes against current files; this verifier does not repeat the reload
